prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: web page hero concept image
Primary request: A concept hero image for a local AI multimodal creative lab. On a dark product workspace, show a left-to-right workflow from screenshot input to a Chinese analysis report, structured prompt cards, and a final concept art asset preview.
Scene/backdrop: restrained dark product workspace with local project folders, abstract screenshot thumbnails, clean analysis report blocks, prompt cards, and an accepted concept image board.
Subject: a verifiable three-step workflow from image or screenshot analysis to structured prompt pack to imagegen concept asset.
Style/medium: polished editorial 3D illustration with realistic product surfaces, not an actual UI screenshot.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, left-to-right process path, clear focal point on the final concept image preview, usable negative space.
Lighting/mood: precise soft studio lighting, calm, capable, inventive.
Color palette: charcoal black, warm white, acid lime accents, restrained cyan details.
Constraints: no external API logos, no random brand marks, no readable fake UI text, no tiny gibberish text, no watermark, no messy clutter, no robots, no neon overload.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square assistant concept portrait for a project asset library
Primary request: An abstract Codex-like creative assistant presence for a local multimodal lab.
Subject: a calm intelligent presence made from layered analysis panes, image tiles, prompt cards, and subtle light geometry; avoid a literal robot cliche or human face realism.
Scene/backdrop: dark local project workspace with small hints of screenshots, reports, and concept asset boards.
Style/medium: refined 3D concept art, premium software identity asset, suitable for an internal AI workflow lab.
Composition/framing: centered 1:1 portrait, strong silhouette, readable at thumbnail size, generous padding.
Lighting/mood: quiet confidence, focused, imaginative, precise soft studio lighting.
Color palette: black glass, soft white, muted teal, small acid lime highlights.
Constraints: no text, no logo, no watermark, no random brand marks, no external API symbols, no clutter.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: scene style frame for a local AI workflow lab
Primary request: A cinematic scene where raw screenshots and image references are transformed into structured storyboard panels and final concept art assets.
Scene/backdrop: local project studio with folders, analysis notes, prompt cards, and image boards arranged in a clean workflow.
Subject: the moment of transformation from visual input to Chinese analysis report to structured prompt pack to imagegen concept output.
Style/medium: sophisticated digital illustration, grounded product storytelling, practical software-lab atmosphere, not decorative abstraction.
Composition/framing: 3:2 landscape-style frame, left-to-right process path, clear separation between input, reasoning, and output.
Lighting/mood: focused creative workshop, practical, elegant, warm highlights with cool shadows.
Color palette: neutral dark surfaces, paper white report panels, selective acid lime and amber signal accents.
Materials/textures: glass panels, matte black desk, printed storyboard sheets, softly glowing asset boards.
Constraints: no external service logos, no random UI text, no watermark, no cluttered composition, no fake brand marks.
